features: A real round timer with the bell, so the site is useful to members and worth coming back to
The week's classes printed as a poster, and any class taps straight into a booking

name: Southpaw
short: Ring the bell on the club clock, then book a free first session from the timetable.
long: The club clock is the centrepiece: ring the bell and a real round runs, three minutes in red, a minute's rest, twelve rounds with the bell. Below it the week is printed like a poster; tap any class and it becomes your free first session, booked with a name and a mobile.
proves: Somebody who has never boxed can pick a level, pick a night this week and be booked in about twenty seconds.
story: Gyms sell on atmosphere and then hide the timetable three clicks deep. This one puts the noise and the booking in the same place, so the page feels like the gym and still books the session.
